user.title: Salda / MCB Modbus TCP
user.description: Connection parameters of the recuperator's Modbus TCP interface.

data.address_offset: Address mode (1 = send addresses exactly as documented (most controllers), 0 = strict 0-based addressing)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the device. Check host, port, slave id and framing, and see the Home Assistant log for the exact pymodbus error. Try slave id 1 if you used 0 (0 is the Modbus broadcast address and most devices never reply to it). If the unit only answers some registers, enable 'Add without connection test'.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see Home Assistant logs for details.
